name: box-local-engine
description: Standalone local-first voxel engine developer preview

scripts.dev:creator: node apps/local-engine/src/launcher.js --creator
scripts.check: node apps/local-engine/src/build-metadata.test.js && node apps/local-engine/scripts/regression-project-storage-identity.js && node scripts/regression-empty-mesh-asset.js && node scripts/check-standalone.js && node scripts/check-play-version-refresh.js && pnpm --filter @box-local/game run test:local-runtime-session && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:model-library-scope && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:model-project-bundle && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:local-cors && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa run check:model-management-permission && pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server run check:disabled-storage && node scripts/platform-api-removal.test.js && node scripts/check-engine-wire-protocols.js && pnpm --filter @box-local/license test && pnpm --filter @box-local/license-server test && node scripts/check-license-boundaries.js && node scripts/check-windows-offline-installer.js && node --test scripts/package-release.test.js scripts/build-desktop-offline-installer.test.js scripts/verify-desktop-offline-package.test.js scripts/linux-bootstrap-installer.test.js && node scripts/check-desktop-deployment-manager.js && node scripts/check-headless-rust-manager.js && node --test scripts/deployment-manager-transport.test.js && node scripts/check-release-workflow.js && node scripts/check-documentation.js && pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server exec node -r @swc-node/register scripts/regression-map-group-state-lock.ts && pnpm --dir examples/player-auth-portal check && cargo test --manifest-path apps/manager-core/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path apps/server-manager-rust/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter @box-local/migrator test && node --test scripts/teleport-room-manager.test.js scripts/teleport-library-integration.test.js
scripts.lint: eslint apps/local-engine/src apps/local-engine/scripts apps/license-server packages/license scripts --ext .js,.cjs && pnpm --filter @box-local/game lint && pnpm --filter @box-local/voxa lint && pnpm --filter @box-local/migrator lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @box-local/local-engine test && pnpm --filter @box-local/game-server test && pnpm check
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
